description:
Engwe M20 2.0 is the upgraded version of Engwe M20 electric fat bike, with double performance, providing you with a better riding experience. Double is better than single!
The Double Performance of Engwe M20 2.0
- Double Battery (Optional): Engwe M20 2.0 offers a double battery option, which is two 52V 15.6Ah batteries, greatly improving the range of this electric bike.
- Double Range: Double batteries bring double range. In throttle-only mode, Engwe M20 2.0 can provide 63 miles of range; if you choose pedal assist mode, the range can reach up to 162 miles.
- Double Comfort: Front 50mm suspension, hydraculic 40mm rear shock and wide plush seat double the riding comfort. Come and enjoy the great riding experience brought by this full suspension bike.
- Double Safety: Double powerful headlights, rear and brake light, hydraulic disc brakes can double your riding safety. Whether it's day or night, your safety is guaranteed.
Other Designs That Make Engwe M20 2.0 More Special
- Moped-like Design: Engwe M20 2.0 follows the exterior design of M20 - with a flying fish-inspired shape. In other words, it is a moped-style electric bike, which is very cool.
- Powerful Motor: This electric bike uses an electric hub motor with a peak power of 1200W, which can provide sufficient power to make your adventure more exciting.
- Off-road wheels: The 20*4.0-inch fat tires can adapt to a variety of terrains, allowing you to easily cross rocky trails, sandy beaches, snowy paths, etc., making Engwe M20 2.0 an electric off road bike.
- Integrated Throttle: It allows you to accelerate easily, boost your riding, and enhance your riding experience.
If you are looking for an electric bike for adventure or off-roading, Engwe M20 2.0 is your ideal choice. This affordable fat tyre electric bicycle will enhance your riding experience and make your journey easier and more comfortable.
